tasks.title: HANGS Construction Services · IRS Notice CP207 Reply
tasks.description: Answer the IRS notice CP207 on the Q2 2026 Form 941 of HANGS Construction Services LLC from 7 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Tie the return as filed to the payroll and the EFTPS deposits, recompute the 2026 deposit schedule from the lookback period, rebuild each pay run’s due date under the $100,000 next-business-day rule, reproduce the IRS’s averaged penalty, figure the correct penalty on the actual paydays and test twelve quarters of history for automatic penalty relief. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and a draft reply package. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an unsigned draft reply package PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
